lyrics:
[Intro: twangy electric guitar lick, shuffle drums]

[Verse 1: grinning male baritone]
Friday at four they handed me a box
Twenty-one years, one plant, one clock
I sat in the truck thinking, well, I'm through
Then I noticed the sky was a real nice blue

[Chorus: full band, fiddle and steel, singalong]
Got fired on a Friday, went fishing on Saturday
Caught my limit by ten
Saw my boy play shortstop Sunday
First time since I don't know when
Slept in Monday, wife rolled over, said, "Who's this guy?"
Best thing that ever happened to me
Was getting fired on a Friday

[Verse 2: baritone, band swinging]
Now the neighbor needs a deck and his brother needs a shed
Turns out I'm pretty handy with what's left in my head
No badge, no meeting, no "circle back"
Just a pencil on my ear and a dog in the back

[Chorus: full band, fiddle and steel, singalong]
Got fired on a Friday, went fishing on Saturday
Caught my limit by ten
Saw my boy play shortstop Sunday
First time since I don't know when
Slept in Monday, wife rolled over, said, "Who's this guy?"
Best thing that ever happened to me
Was getting fired on a Friday

[Bridge: band stops, spoken-sung over a single guitar]
Old boss called, said, "We made a mistake."
I said, "Buddy, so did I. For twenty-one years.
I'm at the lake."

[Final Chorus: band crashes back in, crowd voices]
Got fired on a Friday, went fishing on Saturday
Caught my limit by ten
Saw my boy play shortstop Sunday
First time since I don't know when
Slept in Monday, wife rolled over, said, "Who's this guy?"
Best thing that ever happened to me
Was getting fired on a Friday

[Outro: guitar lick, a fishing reel spinning]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 115 BPM, 4/4 shuffle, G major. Bouncy and broad, a grin set to music.

VOICE: Male baritone, big, friendly and a little rough, with a laugh in it. He belts the chorus without strain. The bridge is spoken-sung with comic timing. Friends shout along in the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: Twangy lead electric guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, strummed acoustic guitar, a walking bass, shuffle drums with a bright snare, honky-tonk piano fills.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro lick. 0:08 Verse 1. 0:30 Chorus 1. 1:00 Verse 2. 1:22 Chorus 2. 1:52 Bridge, band stops for the phone call. 2:10 Final chorus with crowd. 2:42 Outro lick and a reel, ends 2:56.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern country with a 1990s heart: live band, bright guitars, big dry drums, voice out front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The silence before 'I'm at the lake' at 2:06.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original loses a girlfriend and wins the weekend. This one loses a career and gets back a family and a pair of hands, which is the better trade and the more common story now.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Stunned, surprised by the sky, delighted, free.
